checks.text: The page heading is "GIF Maker" and the drop zone shows the text "Drop images or video here".
Clicking the button "Add sample frames" adds three list items labeled "frame-1.png", "frame-2.png" and "frame-3.png" to the frame list, and the summary line shows "Frames: 3".
With the three sample frames present, typing "200" in the field labelled "Frame delay (ms)" and clicking "Apply" changes the summary line to "Frames: 3, Delay: 200ms".
Clicking the button "Delete frame-2.png" removes that item from the list, leaving "frame-1.png" and "frame-3.png", and the summary shows "Frames: 2".
Clicking the tab "Settings" shows the field labelled "Width" with value "800" and the field labelled "Height" with value "600"; clicking the tab "Frames" returns to the frame list.
In the Settings tab, typing "400" in the field labelled "Width" and "300" in the field labelled "Height", then clicking "Apply", changes the summary line to "Frames: 2, Delay: 200ms, Size: 400x300".
Clicking the button "Export GIF" shows a progress ring that completes and then displays the text "GIF ready: gif-maker-800x600.gif" and enables the button "Download".
Clicking the button "Download" copies the filename "gif-maker-800x600.gif" to the clipboard and shows the toast "Copied to clipboard".

Reload keeps the frame list and settings: after adding the sample frames, setting delay to 200 and size to 400x300, reloading the page still shows "Frames: 2, Delay: 200ms, Size: 400x300" and the list items "frame-1.png" and "frame-3.png".
